rows.ARS:
Red blend Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Abracadabra ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, 2004).
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 2014 as 'Abracadabra'.
Introduced in Japan by Keisei Rose Nurseries Inc. in 2016 as 'Toi toi toi!'.
Introduced in Australia by Treloar Roses in 2020 as 'It's Magic'.
rows.Bloom: Red, white stripes, light yellow stripes. Average diameter 3". Medium, very double bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, upright. Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: up to 35" (up to 90cm). Width: up to 4'2" (up to 125cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
